# MVP Requirements Quality Checklist: GhostQA First MVP

**Purpose**: Rigorous reviewer review of implementation readiness, objective acceptance,
reproducibility, and execution safety; not an implementation test checklist.
**Created**: 2026-09-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: Generated by `$speckit-checklist` from the specification and five accepted clarifications.
**Review Ownership**: Reviewer-owned; mark `[x]` only after requirements-quality review.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means requirements quality is satisfied, not that implementation is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are model proposal, deterministic validation, deterministic request execution, and evidence adjudication responsibilities separately specified, with an explicit prohibition on model-authorized or model-issued requests? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, Gap]
- [x] CHK002 Are secret classification, persistence protection, retention/deletion, and model-input disclosure rules defined for static credentials and journey-issued secrets? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-017–019, Gap]
- [x] CHK003 Is the machine-checkable predicate contract defined for developer assertions, explicit specification assertions, agent hypotheses, and baseline checks, including approval and unevaluable results? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-021, Gap]
- [x] CHK004 Are declared facts, inferred dependencies, hypothesized state, and observed transitions defined with provenance and evidence requirements? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK005 Are supported authentication modes and exclusions explicit, with step-local override precedence and journey credential isolation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-024]
- [x] CHK006 Are OpenAPI version/schema support boundaries and JSON/YAML handling defined without allowing the supported subset to exclude every benchmark-critical operation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §SC-011, Assumptions, Gap]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK007 Are named bindings, extraction locations, permitted destinations, generated-value freshness, missing-value behavior, and type compatibility precisely defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK008 Are sensitive-value identification and propagation defined for tokens, passwords, response headers, generated values, encoded URLs, headers, and bodies? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-018, §FR-024, Gap]
- [x] CHK009 Is OBSERVED VIOLATION governed by an observable evidence threshold rather than only “suggest a violation”? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Ambiguity]
- [x] CHK010 Are CONFIRMED, INCONCLUSIVE, NON-REPRODUCED, run failure, and step EXECUTION ERROR semantics distinguished with deterministic transition rules? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, §FR-026, Gap]
- [x] CHK011 Is verified baseline state defined through bounded reset/check sequences, assertion evaluation, relevant-state coverage, and evidence freshness between phases? [Clarity, Spec §FR-021, Gap]
- [x] CHK012 Are normalized origin, port, path-segment boundaries, approved destination sets, and rejection of ambiguous URL forms defined sufficiently to prevent differing interpretations? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, Gap]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK013 Are malformed model-output termination and three rounds of duplicate/invalid hypotheses reconciled so each has a unique stopping outcome? [Consistency, Spec §FR-026, §SC-010, Conflict]
- [x] CHK014 Are expected authentication rejection, unexpected authentication failure, and explicit invariant violations distinguished before the target-failure stopping rule applies? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §FR-026, Ambiguity]
- [x] CHK015 Are snapshot and secret-retention rules consistent with redacted traces and independently runnable replay artifacts? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-014–018, §FR-024, Gap]
- [x] CHK016 Are confirmed finding status and artifact verification status independent when post-confirmation reset, budget, or artifact verification fails? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §FR-021, §FR-025–026]
- [x] CHK017 Are all-phase request/time budgets consistent with exploration-only journey limits, per-trial step limits, and reset/baseline length limits? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-021, §FR-023]
- [x] CHK018 Are three faulty/fixed artifact executions under SC-004 distinguished from one required confirmation replay and one artifact verification under FR-012/025, including their budget accounting? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, §FR-025, §SC-004, Gap]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK019 Does each material functional requirement have traceable observable acceptance criteria, including approval, deletion, failure classification, model policy, and secret handling? [Measurability, Spec §FR-001–026, §SC-001–011, Gap]
- [x] CHK020 Is independent reproduction defined as the same versioned predicate applied to new reset evidence and newly extracted values, without stale IDs/tokens or hidden discovery-state dependencies? [Measurability, Spec §FR-012, §FR-021, §FR-024]
- [x] CHK021 Are minimization objective, dependency validity, accepted reduction evidence, local stopping criterion, interruption outcomes, and prohibited global-minimum claims objectively specified? [Measurability, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK022 Are VERIFIED artifact criteria tied to the exported artifact identity, fresh baseline, intended assertion failure, and distinct repaired-fixture validation? [Measurability, Spec §FR-025, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK023 Are benchmark trials, blinding, faulty/fixed pairs, discovery denominators, configuration recording, and outcome thresholds specified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002–004]
- [x] CHK024 Is redundant-step minimization evaluation defined without requiring autonomous discovery to coincidentally include redundant steps or exposing trigger sequences to the planner? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-004, Ambiguity]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK025 Are primary, alternative, exception, restart, and no-finding outcomes specified without automatic repetition of mutations? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing, §FR-017, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK026 Are fresh-state requirements explicit for every exploration journey, confirmation replay, minimization trial, and exported-artifact verification, with partial reset and unverified baseline outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-021, §SC-009]
- [x] CHK027 Are model unavailability (including Gemini), provider rate limits, malformed structure, hallucinated operations, and invalid bindings assigned explicit rejection/stop and evidence-retention outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-019, §FR-026, Gap]
- [x] CHK028 Are approvals arriving after INCONCLUSIVE, conflicting replay results, and predicate edits assigned lifecycle rules that preserve prior evidence? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007, §FR-012, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK029 Are unresolved/remote references, recursive or ambiguous schemas, unsupported operations, and multiple servers assigned operation-level exclusion behavior and zero-eligible-operation handling? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK030 Are DNS changes, mixed approved addresses, extracted absolute URLs, redirects, path escapes, and disallowed operations covered by the same execution boundary? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, §FR-023, §SC-005]
- [x] CHK031 Are request-budget exhaustion, elapsed-time expiration during model/in-flight work, journey/step limits, and cancellation races assigned observable stop semantics? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, §FR-023, §FR-026, Gap]
- [x] CHK032 Are unavailable or truncated assertion inputs assigned unevaluable outcomes rather than false passing or false confirmation? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, §FR-012, Edge Cases, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK033 Are scope approval, pinned destinations, operation exclusions, mutation acknowledgment, and cancellation obligations required for all phases and the exported artifact verification path? [Security, Spec §FR-004, §FR-023, §FR-025]
- [x] CHK034 Are redaction requirements comprehensive across model inputs, persistent records, diagnostic logs, traces, and exports, with measurable coverage beyond configured-secret literal matches? [Security, Spec §FR-005, §FR-018, §SC-006, Gap]
- [x] CHK035 Are finite model-call deadlines and bounded import/response processing requirements specified so elapsed-time guarantees cannot be bypassed by non-request work? [Reliability, Spec §FR-006, §FR-026, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK036 Are local target reachability, reset/baseline endpoints, credentials, model availability, and absence of concurrent external mutations documented as baseline-validity dependencies? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-021, Gap]
- [x] CHK037 Are supported predicate/schema operators and generation bounds explicitly defined, with only artifact packaging remaining a planning choice rather than an established compatibility claim? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK038 Are benchmark data acquisition requirements compatible with the no-browser, no-OAuth, no-cookie-jar, single-origin MVP, especially reset tokens normally delivered by email? [Dependency, Spec §FR-005, §FR-024, §SC-002, Gap]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK039 Are scope exclusions explicit and free of unnecessary feature requirements for browsers, CI/CD, teams, billing, hosted multi-tenancy, load testing, and penetration testing? [Scope, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK040 Are undefined terms such as “eligible predicate,” “ambiguous generation schema,” “new valid hypothesis,” and “relevant response evidence” resolved or assigned explicit pre-implementation decision gates? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-010, §FR-026, Gap]

## Notes

- Original generation left markers unchecked. On explicit reviewer authorization, the second
  clarification pass assessed each item and marked it satisfied against the updated spec.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle; it was not changed by this review.
- Original assessment below is preserved as review history. The second-pass resolution record
  supersedes it: all ten issues have specification resolutions and acceptance traceability.
- Setup's prerequisite script required absent plan.md. This pre-planning review used the active
  feature pointer and successfully resolved checklist-template directly. No plan/tasks exist;
  no extension hooks are configured.

### Assisted Review — Issues to Resolve Before Technical Planning

| ID | Severity / quality problem | Evidence | Required resolution within current scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | High — missing secret lifecycle | FR-018 covers “configured secrets”; FR-005 adds journey credentials; neither defines model-input disclosure or storage protection. | Specify sensitive field marking/propagation, redaction before model calls, protected credential storage, evidence retention/deletion, and placeholder rebinding without exposing secret values. |
| R2 | High — undefined predicate/reset contract | FR-007 allows “explicit specification assertion”; FR-021 requires baseline assertions, but supported operators and their source representation are deferred. | Define the minimal declarative assertion profile, how assertions enter the project, immutable predicate identity, baseline check outcomes, and unevaluable/truncated input handling. Define freshness relative to external mutations; checks establish only the declared baseline. |
| R3 | High — inconsistent model stopping | FR-026 stops on “invalid structured output”; SC-010 expects three rounds of “duplicate/invalid hypotheses.” | Separate malformed/unauthorized plans (immediate stop) from valid but duplicate/non-useful proposals (stagnation counter), or select a single consistent rule. Specify bounded model-call deadlines and provider rate-limit handling; Gemini is mentioned in the review request, not selected in the spec. |
| R4 | High — incomplete failure taxonomy | FR-012 lists finding states; FR-026 uses “authentication rejection that prevents planned execution.” EXECUTION ERROR has no contract. | Define run/step error reasons separately from finding states, how expected rejection is declared before a request, and transitions when approval or later replay evidence arrives. Never let model interpretation alone decide execution validity. |
| R5 | High — unbounded processing and ambiguous budget ends | FR-006 lists time/step limits but not model-call interruption, response/import bounds, or the consequence of an overlong generated journey. | Define budget start/end, admission checks, in-flight deadline behavior, step-limit rejection versus termination, and finite bounds for non-request work. Preserve cancellation's no-new-requests rule. |
| R6 | High — compatibility contract too open | FR-002 promises a reported subset while Assumptions defer supported operators and bounds. | Enumerate minimum required methods, parameter/body forms, schema constructs, supported 3.0/3.1 differences, and predicate operators before implementation; ensure all benchmark-critical operations remain supported. |
| R7 | High — regression execution boundary incomplete | FR-025 requires execution of exported artifacts; FR-023 applies safety to verification, without defining whether the artifact shares the validated executor or a separate transport. | Require equivalent pinned scope, budgets, cancellation, credential placeholders, and reset checks for artifact verification; state the reproducibility boundary for standalone use. Choose packaging during planning without weakening the safety contract. |
| R8 | Medium — benchmark setup and measurement ambiguity | SC-002 requires blind discovery; SC-004 requires redundant-step removal and three faulty/fixed executions. | Separate blind discovery trials from minimization acceptance using redundant recorded journeys; specify fixture token acquisition through supported HTTP responses, expected predicates, reset checks, blinding, and whether paired artifact checks are separately budgeted acceptance runs. No trigger sequences go to discovery planning. |
| R9 | Medium — canonical URL and special header gaps | FR-004 says “after canonicalization”; FR-005 permits static/overridden headers without reservations. | Specify rejection rules for ambiguous encoded paths, userinfo, fragments, and host/transport-control headers; reconcile explicit destination approval with all request URL construction. |
| R10 | Medium — acceptance traceability gaps | SC-001–011 cover broad groups, but FR-001 deletion, predicate approval, sensitive persistence/model inputs, and rejection classifications lack explicit pass/fail criteria. | Add observable acceptance coverage for these requirements and the failure taxonomy; keep requirements focused on the existing MVP. |

### Assisted Review — Established Strengths

- FR-004/023 explicitly bound origins, ports, addresses, paths, operations, mutation approval,
  redirects, and cancellation while permitting intentional local/private targets.
- FR-021 requires reset plus baseline checks before all four trial types and stops on partial or
  unverifiable reset. FR-012 requires original violation plus an independent fresh-state replay.
- FR-003/019/024 distinguish evidence provenance, model proposals, deterministic validation, and
  declarative value flow without invented missing IDs or stale replay tokens.
- FR-013 specifies dependency-preserving local minimization without global-minimum claims.
- FR-025 separates confirmed findings from artifact verification; SC-002 specifies blind seeded
  discovery against faulty/fixed pairs with measurable thresholds.
- Excluded product capabilities remain outside scope. These findings request precision, not expansion.

### Second Clarification Pass — Resolution Record (2026-09-30)

Five product decisions accepted: encrypted/symbolic secret handling; immutable declarative
predicates; fixed OpenAPI profile; full-trial request admission and deadlines; fresh authority
for independent artifacts. Minimal cleanup resolves failure taxonomy, baseline evidence,
processing bounds, URL/header ambiguity, benchmark measurement, and acceptance traceability.
No technical plan, application code, or constitution was changed.

| Original issue | Resolution |
| --- | --- |
| R1 | FR-018 and SC-012/AP-005 define sensitive fields, propagation, encryption, key failure, symbolic records, model exclusion, retention and deletion. |
| R2 | FR-007/021 define assertion profile, identity, all verdicts, baseline ownership and interference assumptions; AP-008/011 cover them. |
| R3 | FR-026 distinguishes immediate invalid-plan/model stops from three valid non-useful rounds; FR-006/028 bound all loops. |
| R4 | FR-012/026 define separate finding/run/step classifications, expected rejection, later approval and conflicting evidence. |
| R5 | FR-006/028 define admission, dispatch accounting, deadlines, step limits, import/response/model bounds; AP-009 exercises them. |
| R6 | FR-002/028 fix the REST/schema/nullability/serialization profile and bounds; benchmark operations must conform. |
| R7 | FR-025 requires independent fresh scope approval and equal safety obligations; artifact metadata grants no authority. |
| R8 | FR-029, SC-002/004, AP-002/003 and fixture assumptions define blind discovery, counters, paired artifact trials and separate redundant-step minimization. |
| R9 | FR-027 defines ambiguous URL rejection and reserved transport headers under the frozen FR-004 scope. |
| R10 | AP-001–011 map every functional requirement and SC-001–013 to observable acceptance procedures. |

**Re-evaluation:** 0/40 → 40/40 satisfied for requirements quality. No items remain unchecked.
CHK037 was updated to reflect that schema/predicate/bounds contracts are now specified, while
artifact packaging alone remains a planning choice. Marks do not certify implementation or
benchmark performance; these are acceptance targets to validate after implementation.
